brief.headline: Nifty Set for Weak Open; Hawkish Fed Minutes and Nvidia Leadership Woes Weigh
brief.summary: GIFT Nifty indicates a lower opening after sliding 133 pts despite strong Nvidia earnings. Global sentiment remains fragile as Fed minutes signal further rate hikes and Anthropic prices its IPO at $83 per share. Domestically, Goldman Sachs upgraded India to overweight with a Dec.'27 Nifty target of 28,500.

takeaways.text: GIFT Nifty slid 133 pts, signaling a weak opening for Indian benchmarks despite Nvidia's revenue doubling.
Goldman Sachs upgraded India to overweight, setting a Dec.'27 Nifty target of 28,500 as MSCI India valuation risks rebalance.
Goldman Sachs projects RBI repo rate to climb 75 bps to 6.25% by mid-2027 amid 5.7% inflation expectations.
Fed minutes showed almost all officials anticipate raising rates in coming months to achieve the 2% inflation target.
Anthropic priced its IPO above the marketed range at $83 per share, trading under ticker ANT on Nasdaq.
Nvidia halted shipments of advanced AI chips to China and board reaffirmed Jensen Huang will not return as CEO.

sections.india: Indian equities enter today's session with a negative bias after GIFT Nifty tumbled 133 pts overnight, following yesterday's drop where Nifty closed at 25227.95 and Bank Nifty closed at 62038.65. Goldman Sachs upgraded India to overweight with a Dec.'27 target of 28,500, though it separately projected the RBI repo rate could rise 75 bps to 6.25% by mid-2027. Sectoral pressure remains visible after Nifty Metal lost 2.46 per cent and Nifty Consumer Durables fell 3.13 per cent yesterday. Meanwhile, the benchmark bond yield rose to 7.2858% following profit booking.
sections.world: Wall Street finished mixed overnight, with the Dow dropping 1.11% while the Nasdaq gained 0.42% as markets absorbed Nvidia earnings and hawkish Fed minutes. Minutes of the October FOMC meeting revealed that almost all officials anticipate raising interest rates in the months ahead. European sentiment was pressured as UK October inflation climbed to a one-year high of 3.6%. In commodities, Brent crude slipped 4.41% to $89.03 per barrel and Gold dropped 3.54% to $3727.3.
sections.tech: Anthropic priced its initial public offering at $83 per share, exceeding its initial range and setting up its debut on Nasdaq under ticker ANT. Nvidia posted a massive earnings beat with its $130 billion forecast, but shares faced headwinds as interim CEO Colette Kress affirmed the company has stopped shipping advanced AI chips to China. Furthermore, Chairman Harvey Jones reiterated that the board unanimously accepted Jensen Huang's resignation and has no plans to reinstate him. Microsoft noted that its Copilot product is winning corporate clients over Anthropic and OpenAI due to lower operating costs.

stories.title: Goldman Sachs upgrades India to overweight; Dec.'27 Nifty target at 28,500
stories.summary: As regards the Indian markets, risks look more balanced today versus the 2024 peak, Goldman Sachs said, as MSCI India has de-rated substantially across most parameters.
stories.ai_summary: Goldman Sachs upgraded Indian equities to overweight, setting a December 2027 Nifty target of 28,500. The brokerage noted that valuation risks look more balanced now as MSCI India has derated across major parameters.
stories.why_it_matters: Positive for institutional flows into large-cap Nifty 50 constituents.

stories.title: India bonds reverse intraday gains to end lower as profit booking takes center stage
stories.summary: Indian government bonds faced a setback as profit-seeking traders reacted to earlier gains, with the benchmark bond yield increasing to 7.2858% compared to the previous closure. The fluctuations in crude prices have influenced the market outlook on the Reserve Bank of India, prompting analysts to predict a potential rate increase in December amidst rising retail inflation.
stories.ai_summary: Indian government bonds reversed intraday gains as profit booking took center stage. The benchmark bond yield rose to close at 7.2858%.
stories.why_it_matters: Higher yields may dampen appetite for banking and rate-sensitive stocks.

stories.title: Govt to charge bulk Scotch imports 162.5% duty and tax amid UK pact standoff
stories.summary: India has implemented a hefty 162.5% duty on bulk Scotch imports, surpassing previously established tariffs. This action follows a trade agreement with the UK that aimed to reduce Scotch tariffs to 75%. Investigators claim that Scotch imports are being misclassified, resulting in higher taxes on these goods. Major companies like Pernod Ricard and Diageo are facing disruptions due to blocked shipments at ports.
stories.ai_summary: The Indian government has levied a 162.5% duty and tax on bulk Scotch imports amid a trade pact standoff with the UK. The move comes after discussions stalled regarding lowering duties to 75%.
stories.why_it_matters: Negative for foreign liquor importers; positive for domestic spirits manufacturers.

stories.summary: The case relates to Yes Bank's rescue in 2020, when authorities wrote off Rs 8,415 crore worth of additional Tier-1 (AT1) bonds. These securities are designed to absorb losses when banks face financial distress.
stories.ai_summary: The RBI warned that court decisions regarding Yes Bank's write-off of Rs 8,415 crore of AT1 bonds could undermine future banking rescue mechanisms.

stories.title: Apple iPhone 18 launch tipped for 2027: Same screen size and battery as iPhone 18e? What we know so far

stories.title: Nvidia rejects Jensen Huang's offer to return as CEO despite pressure from Silicon Valley
stories.summary: The embattled company's board of directors "unanimously accepted his resignation and does not intend to reinstate Jensen as CEO," Nvidia Chairman Harvey Jones said at the start of Nvidia's quarterly earnings call before yielding to Chief Financial Officer Colette Kress, who is running the company as a permanent replacement is sought.
stories.ai_summary: Nvidia Chairman Harvey Jones stated the board unanimously accepted Jensen Huang's resignation and has no plans to reinstate him as CEO.
stories.why_it_matters: Removes near-term leadership clarity, creating overhang on AI semiconductor sentiment.

stories.title: Nvidia earnings beat estimates; firm won't take questions on resignation
stories.summary: Nvidia later began a conference call with analysts and investors by saying it wouldn't take questions on longtime CEO Jensen Huang's resignation and doesn't plan to reinstate him. Colette Kress, interim CEO, told investors the company expects revenue to rise 75% in fiscal 2028.
